description.value: The Orca Cottage is a private luxury annex of Langara Fishing Lodge, nestled among the trees of Henslung Cove on remote Langara Island at the northern tip of Haida Gwaii. It accommodates up to 14 guests across a king-bed master suite and six queen-bed double rooms, with cedar-lined ensuite bathrooms, a lounge with stone fireplace, and a wine cellar. Access is exclusively by charter jet from Vancouver and helicopter transfer — there are no roads to or on this part of the island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Orca Cottage is a real, operating private luxury lodge cottage at Langara Fishing Lodge on Langara Island, open for reservations. However, the FAQ explicitly states guests arrive via 'charter jet plane' from Vancouver and 'helicopter transfer to the Lodge' — there is no road access to Langara Island, making it physically unreachable by bicycle. No cycling-related amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, and the minimum booking requirement (10 guests for exclusive reservation) further underscores its nature as a remote, fly-in fishing resort rather than a touring cyclist destination.
concerns: Langara Island is a remote island with no road connections; the only access is by charter jet from Vancouver and helicopter transfer to the lodge — no cycling route exists.
OSM has no address or phone number for this record; phone sourced from website only.
